entries.name: Amazon SageMaker
entries.definition: An Amazon Web Services service for building, training and deploying machine-learning models.

entries.name: Amazon SimpleDB
entries.definition: An Amazon Web Services non-relational database service that stores items made of attributes without a fixed schema.

entries.name: amCharts
entries.definition: A JavaScript library for building interactive charts and maps.

entries.name: American Welding Society codes
entries.definition: The welding codes and standards published by the American Welding Society, such as AWS D1.1 for structural steel.

entries.name: Amiga
entries.definition: A line of personal computers launched by Commodore in 1985, known for its graphics and sound.

entries.name: AMX programming
entries.definition: Writing control programs for AMX audio-visual control systems, typically in the NetLinx language.

entries.name: Anaconda
entries.definition: A distribution of Python and R with a package and environment manager, aimed at data science.

entries.name: Analogue electronics
entries.definition: Electronics that works with continuously varying signals rather than digital ones, as in amplifiers and filters.

entries.name: Analysis of variance
entries.definition: A statistical method that tests whether the means of several groups differ by comparing variation between and within the groups.

entries.name: Anaplan
entries.definition: A cloud platform for business planning, forecasting and modelling.

entries.name: Ancient history
entries.definition: The study of human history from the earliest written records to the end of antiquity.

entries.name: Ancient philosophy
entries.definition: The study of the philosophical thought of the ancient Greek and Roman worlds, such as Plato, Aristotle and the Stoics.

entries.name: Andragogy
entries.definition: The theory and practice of teaching and training adults, as distinct from teaching children.

entries.name: Android app development
entries.definition: Building applications that run on the Android mobile operating system.

entries.name: Android UI development
entries.definition: Building the screens and controls of an Android app, using Android's view system or Jetpack Compose.

entries.name: Anglo-American Cataloguing Rules
entries.definition: A set of rules for describing and cataloguing library materials, published jointly by library associations in the US, UK and Canada.

entries.name: Angular
entries.definition: The Angular framework, distinct from AngularJS.

entries.name: Angular CLI
entries.definition: The official command-line tool for creating, building, testing and serving Angular projects.

entries.name: AngularJS
entries.definition: The AngularJS framework, distinct from Angular.

entries.name: Anim8or
entries.definition: A free 3D modelling and animation program for Windows.

entries.name: Animal science
entries.definition: The study of farm and other domestic animals, including their breeding, nutrition, health and management.

entries.name: Animated explainer video production
entries.definition: Making short animated videos that explain a product, idea or process.

entries.name: Anma massage
entries.definition: A traditional Japanese form of massage that uses kneading and pressing of the body.

entries.name: Anthropometrics
entries.definition: The measurement of human body dimensions such as height, weight and limb proportions, used for example in ergonomics and health.

entries.name: Anti-bribery and corruption
entries.definition: The laws, policies and controls that organisations use to prevent, detect and respond to bribery and corruption.

entries.name: Antics3D
entries.definition: Software for making 3D computer animations.

entries.name: Antivirus software
entries.definition: Software that detects, blocks and removes malicious software such as viruses, worms and ransomware from a computer or network.

entries.name: Apache Airflow
entries.definition: An open-source platform for writing, scheduling and monitoring data workflows as Python code.

entries.name: Apache Ambari
entries.definition: An Apache project for provisioning, managing and monitoring Hadoop clusters.

entries.name: Apache Ant
entries.definition: A Java-based build automation tool that is driven by XML build files.

entries.name: Apache Archiva
entries.definition: A repository manager that stores and serves build artifacts such as Maven packages.

entries.name: Apache Beam
entries.definition: An open-source programming model for defining batch and streaming data-processing pipelines that run on engines such as Apache Spark, Apache Flink and Google Cloud Dataflow.

entries.name: Apache Cassandra
entries.definition: An open-source distributed NoSQL database that stores data in wide columns and is built to stay available across many servers.

entries.name: Apache Cocoon
entries.definition: A Java web development framework built around pipelines that process XML.

entries.name: Apache Giraph
entries.definition: An open-source system for large-scale graph processing, built on Hadoop and modelled on Google's Pregel.

entries.name: Apache Gump
entries.definition: A continuous-integration tool that builds and tests many open-source projects together against the latest source of each other.

entries.name: Apache Jena
entries.definition: A Java framework for building semantic web and linked-data applications, with an RDF API and a SPARQL query engine.

entries.name: Apache jUDDI
entries.definition: An open-source Java implementation of the UDDI (Universal Description, Discovery and Integration) registry for web services.

entries.name: Apache Karaf
entries.definition: An Apache runtime container for deploying and managing OSGi-based Java applications.

entries.name: Apache Lenya
entries.definition: A Java content management system that is built on Apache Cocoon and stores content as XML.
